summary: Construct the triality kernel for GL₂ over a nonarchimedean field, identify its Kirillov spectral action and use it to define an exotic symmetric monoidal structure on smooth representations. Over global function fields, use the theta functional to construct the compact automorphic algebra and its fully faithful category of modules. Include spin-dependent spherical convolution and the sequel’s automorphic induction, restriction, component decomposition and irreducible comparison, with every unresolved proof and supplier extension explicitly recorded.

nodes.title: Singular orbit comparison
nodes.statement: For a smooth V such that neither V nor its smooth contragredient Ṽ admits an SL₂(F)-invariant linear functional, the singular quotient satisfies Ṽ⊗G S({det m=0}×F×)⊗G V ≅ Jac(Ṽ)⊗T Jac(V), with T=F××F× and unnormalized Jacquet functors.
hypotheses: F is a nonarchimedean local field with char F ≠ 2; G = GL₂(F); coefficients are ℂ; e is a fixed nontrivial continuous additive character. All representations and relative tensors are smooth.
proofSteps: Separate the rank-zero and rank-one strata. The zero stratum is Q=S(F×), on which each outer G acts through determinant; the hypotheses imply V_SL₂=Ṽ_SL₂=0.
Apply the smooth two-group spectral sequence E²_i,j=Tor^G_i(Ṽ,Tor^G_j(V,Q))⇒Tor^(G×G)_(i+j)(Ṽ⊗V,Q). Since Tor^G_0(V,Q)=0, the terms (0,0) and (1,0) vanish.

The residual outer action on Tor^G_1(V,Q) still factors through determinant: every SL₂ element induces the identity on Q, hence the identity on its derived tensor by functoriality. Thus E²_0,1=Ṽ⊗G Tor^G_1(V,Q)=0, using Ṽ_SL₂=0. This proves the required total-degree-one vanishing without flatness.

The long exact sequence now identifies the rank-one balanced tensor with the full singular quotient. Compute its stabilizer and use induction/coinvariant adjunctions to obtain the two unnormalized Jacquet modules balanced over T.
acceptance: The hypothesis excludes determinant characters.
The rank-zero term and the relevant degree-one connecting map are both addressed explicitly.

nodes.statement: The realization Modaut(G)→Mod(G) is fully faithful; its essential image is closed under subobjects, quotients, arbitrary limits and colimits, and the smooth transpose dual Dτ. nodes.title: Unramified spin structure
nodes.statement: On the smooth proper curve C of F, an unramified spin structure is a line bundle L with an isomorphism η:L⊗L≅ΩC. For a nonzero rational section s, set ω=η(s⊗s), use its residue character eω on A/F, and define the O_A-lattice Λω by self-duality under eω. Every local order of ω is even; this gives a unique such fractional O_A-lattice. The general line-bundle, tensor and canonical-sheaf carriers are imported, not defined here.
hypotheses: F is a global function field with full finite constant field of odd characteristic; A is its adele ring; G = GL₂(A), Γ = GL₂(F); e is a nontrivial character of A/F; coefficients are ℂ.

In a local trivialization write ω=u t² times a local differential generator; compute the local annihilator of a fractional O lattice.
Even order makes the equation Λ=Λ⊥ have a unique integral-exponent solution.

nodes.title: Spin spherical convolution
nodes.statement: Put H=SL₂(O_A) and C=I_H≅I^H, using compact averaging over ℂ. Identify C with the smooth part underlineHomG(EA,I): inside full Hom, take the union of the images of precomposition by the normalized averaging idempotents eJ, for compact open J containing H. For the corresponding maps f,g define f⋆g=mI(f⊛g)ΔA. This preserves C and makes it a commutative quasi-unital algebra for ordinary tensor: multiplication induces C⊗C C≅C. The scalar centre is explicitly ZG=End(IdMod(G)); z acts by zI∘f. No identification with a spectral function space is required.

Apply the coalgebra and algebra laws to convolution, verifying that the output remains in the smooth Hom carrier.
Use finite-level local centre units and restricted tensor reference compatibility to prove quasi-unitality. Central balance of the kernel gives (z f)⋆g=z(f⋆g)=f⋆(z g), for z∈ZG.

It is an algebra over the appropriate locally unital adelic centre. No identification with functions on an unramified spectral space is asserted.
